title: Wire Meta Pixel conversion tracking through GTM
requirements: Load Meta Pixel via Google Tag Manager and configure the base PageView event.
Track key lead and engagement events such as ViewContent, Contact, Lead, and outbound booking clicks.
Align event names and payloads with Meta's recommended conversion events for ad optimization.
Add debug and verification instructions for validating pixel fires in staging and production.
notes:
DONE (awaiting review). The Meta Pixel is loaded THROUGH GTM (single-loader rule, docs/tracking.md §3) — no hard-coded fbq() snippet is injected anywhere. The app only *describes* the pixel and enriches each dataLayer push with Meta fields; the actual tags live in the GTM container.

>>> WHERE TO ADD THE PIXEL ID (user action required) <<<
The pixel id is NOT hard-coded. Set VITE_META_PIXEL_ID in TWO places:
  1. Local dev: projects/fever_dream/.env.local (copy from .env.example). e.g. VITE_META_PIXEL_ID=123456789012345
  2. Production: GitHub repo → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → Variables tab → add VITE_META_PIXEL_ID.
     The weekly workflow .github/workflows/rebuild-deploy.yml already passes it into `npm run build`.
When unset, the pixel is a clean no-op (nothing pushed, no tag fires).

IMPLEMENTATION:
(1) src/lib/metaPixel.js (NEW) — SSR-safe, side-effect-free module. Exports: getMetaPixelId(), isMetaPixelConfigured(), META_EVENT_MAP (canonical→Meta standard event), getMetaEventName(), buildMetaFields() (emits meta_event_name, meta_event_id, meta_value, meta_currency, meta_content_ids, meta_content_type, meta_content_name), getMetaPixelConfig(), buildMetaPixelBootstrap() (pushes {event:'meta_pixel_init', meta_pixel_id}). Canonical event names are duplicated as string literals (CANONICAL_EVENTS) to avoid a circular import with tracking.js.
(2) src/lib/tracking.js — imports buildMetaFields/buildMetaPixelBootstrap; every track() push is now enriched with Meta fields (merged last so canonical payload cannot clobber them); new initMetaPixel() publishes the pixel id to the dataLayer at startup.
(3) src/main.jsx — calls initMetaPixel() before render so GTM can load the pixel and fire the initial PageView in order.
(4) src/components/RouteTracker.jsx (NEW) — fires exactly one page_view per SPA navigation; skips the first render so the landing PageView is owned by GTM's base-code tag (no double-count). Wired into src/layouts/MainLayout.jsx.
(5) Conversion events wired into components: view_show (ShowDetail on mount), ticket_click (ShowCard placement='card', ShowDetail placement='detail'), contact (BookingForm on view), generate_lead (BookingForm on successful Firestore write), subscribe (SubscribeBanner on successful write).
(6) scripts/verify-meta-pixel.mjs (NEW) + npm scripts `verify:meta` and `verify:tracking` — asserts pixel id configured, all 6 canonical events map to Meta standard events, Meta fields emitted correctly, commerce/content fields forwarded, bootstrap carries the id, GTM container present, and NO hard-coded fbq( base code leaked into the build.
(7) docs/tracking.md — new §8 (Meta Pixel contract): where the id lives, canonical→Meta mapping table, GTM container setup steps (base code + event tags + Data Layer Variables + consent checks), debug/verification (automated + Meta Pixel Helper + GTM Preview + Meta Test Events), privacy.
(8) README.md — new 'Meta Pixel Conversion Tracking' section with the '➕ Where to add the Pixel id' steps and the event mapping table.
(9) .env.example + .github/workflows/rebuild-deploy.yml — clarified VITE_META_PIXEL_ID placement.
(10) eslint.config.js — added src/lib/metaPixel.js to the Node-context globals block.

VALIDATION:
- `npm run build` succeeds; 16/16 pages prerendered; GTM container GTM-MQ858WZ3 detected.
- `npm run verify:gtm` passes all 8 checks (16/16 pages carry the snippet).
- `npm run verify:meta` with VITE_META_PIXEL_ID unset correctly reports the no-op path (exit 0).
- `VITE_META_PIXEL_ID=123456789012345 node scripts/verify-meta-pixel.mjs` passes all 19 checks.
- `npx eslint` clean on all new/changed files.
- Fixed a pre-existing unused import (slugifyEvent) in src/pages/ShowDetail.jsx while editing it.

REMAINING (blocked on user): add the real Pixel id to .env.local + the GitHub Actions variable, then create the Meta tags in the GTM container per docs/tracking.md §8.3. The next task (tracking-validation-and-documentation) will verify the live fires.
